title: Transport plan
summary: Three depots supply four customers, and every route has its own cost per crate. Find the cheapest plan that meets every order without sending more than a depot holds.
origin: Written for this project: spec 2's transport example (benchmarks/transport), with its optimum proved by LP duality (docs/research/spec-4-template-sources.md); PuLP's MIT-licensed beer distribution problem was the fallback and is not used.
